title: apocynum pumilum var. typicum
intro: Apocynum pumilum var. typicum, commonly known as Dwarf Dogbane, is a plant species native to North America, characterized by its small, greenish-yellow flowers and red or purple berries. The health benefits of Dwarf Dogbane include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include diuretic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which may be beneficial in treating conditions such as hypertension, kidney stones, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Apocynum pumilum var. typicum include cardenolides, such as digoxin and gitoxin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
